mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for stucco replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a stucco replacement contractor, look for one with a strong local reputation, proven experience specifically with stucco, and appropriate licensing and insurance. Check their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining all costs, materials, and project timelines. Communication skills and a clear understanding of your project's needs are also vital for a successful outcome.
